frame_row: Structural top of the asynchronous AXI bridge. It instantiates one module per AXI channel and holds no logic of its own. The subordinate-side interface is on the left and the manager-side interface is on the right.

label: u_aw
(m_vlsit_axi_async_aw)
blocks.function: AW channel. It packs every field of the AXI write address channel into one word, writes it into an asynchronous Gray-code FIFO in the clock domain of the source side, and unpacks the word on the other side of the clock boundary. The handshake maps directly: the source ready is the inverse of the FIFO full flag and the destination valid is the inverse of the FIFO empty flag. The order of the words is kept and no field is changed or checked. Optional fields that are not present are not stored.
